title: Multiplicity binomiality conjecture for Burnside-chain eigenvalues
statement:
Fix $k$, and let $\lambda$ be any nonzero eigenvalue of the Burnside chain on $(C_k^n,S_n)$ for any $n$. **Multiplicity binomiality conjecture.** The eigenvalue $\lambda$ occurs with multiplicity

$$
a_\lambda\binom{n}{b_\lambda}
$$

for some integers $a_\lambda,b_\lambda$. This conjecture is motivated by the Schur--Weyl decomposition and seeks a uniform description of eigenvalue multiplicities as $n$ varies; proving it would help provide matching upper bounds for mixing time.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.01245

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of November 2025).
source_name: Persi Diaconis, Andrew Lin and Arun Ram, “A curiously slowly mixing Markov chain”, arXiv:2511.01245 (2025).
